---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspection Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
rest_inspec =
  rest_inspec |>
  select(
    boro, grade, score, dba,
    latitude, longitude, inspection_date
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(score),
    !is.na(grade),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude),
    boro == "Manhattan",
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    latitude != 0,
    longitude != 0
  )
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A

```{r}
# Plotly
rest_inspec |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Score", score, "Grade", grade)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~latitude, y = ~longitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~score, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5)
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart B

```{r}
# plotly bar chart
rest_inspec |>
  filter(grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")) |>
  count(grade) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~grade, y = ~n, type = "bar", color = ~grade)
```

### Chart C

```{r}
# plotly boxplot
rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    !is.na(score),
    !is.na(grade)
  ) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~grade, y = ~score, type = "box")
```
